cds.title: Loyola Marymount University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research, version dated 2026-05-18)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-2027 from the CDS G1/G5 and the LMU Student Accounts 2026/2027 schedule: tuition $68,042 ($34,021 per semester; $2,840 per unit part-time); required fees $1,398 for a first-year (CDS; includes the $500 one-time New Student Fee; continuing undergraduates pay $898); on-campus food and housing $21,661 (housing $14,411 + meal plan $7,250); books and supplies $1,305. International students also pay a one-time $1,200 New International Student Fee (shown as the extra fee) and a $75 International Student Fee each semester, and must carry student health insurance (2026-27 premiums $1,164 fall and $1,612 spring, pending state approval). total_coa_usd is the published 'Estimated Total Cost' for on-campus undergraduates ($99,289) on LMU's 2026-2027 cost of attendance page; it uses LMU's own housing-and-food average ($23,602) and adds personal expenses ($3,969), parking and transportation ($1,386) and federal loan fees ($88), so it does not equal the components listed here. intl_avg_award_usd is the CDS H6 average institutional (non-need-based) award to 367 nonresident undergraduates ($1,472,898 in total).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class, version dated 2026-05-18): 22,798 applied, 10,992 admitted, 1,536 enrolled. Residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international, by address) add up to the totals. International: 2,707 applied, 153 admitted, 104 enrolled (the B2 nonresident first-year count is 104). The early decision figures cover Early Decision I and II together (the CDS lists no early action counts). Waiting list: 6,148 offered a place and 208 admitted; the CDS leaves the number who accepted a place blank ('--'), so it is not shown. SAT/ACT submission is optional: 20% of enrolled first-years submitted the SAT (306 students) and 7% the ACT (100); the percentile ranges cover those submitters only. The average GPA of 3.98 is as reported (the CDS does not say whether it is weighted); 100% of first-years reported a GPA. Undergraduate enrollment (7,187) and the nonresident count (611) are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures. Admit rate by these counts is about 48%.

cds_test_policy.notes: From CDS C8: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.
